tasks.title: Change app title to a funny name across all files and tests
tasks.description:
1. WHAT: Change the app title from 'Mini Calculator' to 'Crunchy Number Muncher' (a funny calculator name) in all locations, and update the HTML page title too. 2. READ FIRST: Read `index.html` (line 7 has Chris Min Calc), `src/App.tsx` (line 55 has

Mini Calculator

), and `src/App.test.tsx` (references 'Mini Calculator' in multiple assertions). 3. FILES: Modify `index.html` — change to 'Crunchy Number Muncher'. Modify `src/App.tsx` — change the <h1> text to 'Crunchy Number Muncher'. Modify `src/App.test.tsx` — update ALL occurrences of 'Mini Calculator' to 'Crunchy Number Muncher' (there are ~8 references including getByText, queryByText, and .closest calls). 4. APPROACH: Simple find-and-replace of the title string in all three files. No logic changes needed. 5. PATTERNS: The test file uses screen.getByText('Mini Calculator') and screen.queryByText('Mini Calculator') — replace all with the new title.
acceptance_criteria: After logging in, the page heading displays 'Crunchy Number Muncher' instead of 'Mini Calculator'
The browser tab title shows 'Crunchy Number Muncher'
